name: four-seeds
cmd: set -e; for t in 1995 1985; do for s in 3 4; do for st in '' _late; do C={cache}/desk_tempho_${t}_s${s}${st}; for x in esk_annual.npy esk_epochs.npz; do [ -e $C/$x ] || cp {cache}/desk_tempho_${t}_s1/$x $C/$x; done; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache $C --out {out}/desk_tempho_${t}_s${s}${st} --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --null-desk --tag _strong4; {python} research/exp/shift_null.py --cache $C --out {out}/desk_tempho_${t}_s${s}${st}; done; done; done
summarize: for d in {out}/desk_tempho_*; do echo == $(basename $d); {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --summarize $d | grep -E 'DESK gain|NULL'; {python} research/exp/shift_null.py --summarize $d | grep desk_within; done
note: E046: seeds 3-4 (E032 models) for E039n (late-state gain beyond the strong base), E039o (null) and E044b (DESK specificity)
